screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial of inosiplex (systemic immunomodulator) in patients with alopecia totalis. Evaluates effectiveness (hair regrowth). Meets inclusion criteria: RCT of systemic intervention for AA/AT/AU.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial of oral prednisolone pulse therapy (systemic corticosteroid) in extensive AA. Evaluates hair regrowth. Meets criteria.
Multicenter randomized controlled investigator-blinded trial comparing two topical corticosteroid formulations (BVF vs BDL) in mild-to-moderate AA. Evaluates effectiveness. Meets criteria.
Double-blind placebo-controlled RCT of topical minoxidil for extensive AA, including alopecia totalis and universalis. Evaluates hair growth. Meets criteria.
Double-blind RCT of 3% topical minoxidil vs placebo in extensive AA (including 25-100% scalp hair loss). Evaluates effectiveness. Meets criteria.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing topical DPCP alone vs DPCP+minoxidil in chronic severe AA. Evaluates clinical and immunologic outcomes. Meets criteria.

Randomized trial assigning patients with alopecia totalis who failed sensitizing therapies to three active treatments (topical cyclosporine, PUVA, IV thymopentin). Although no placebo, it is an RCT evaluating interventions. Meets criteria.
Not a randomized controlled trial. Six patients received different ALA lotion concentrations within-patient; no random allocation or control group; pilot study design.
Randomized trial comparing topical cyclosporin A vs vehicle in patients with AA. Evaluates hair regrowth. Meets criteria.
Double-blind placebo-controlled RCT of imipramine (systemic antidepressant) in AA. Evaluates hair regrowth as outcome. Meets criteria.
Randomized trial with three parallel groups: topical immunotherapy (SADBE), systemic interferon-alpha, and combination, for severe AA. Evaluates effectiveness. Meets criteria.
Double-blind study assessing topical cyclosporin A vs placebo in AA patients. Although not explicitly 'randomized', described as double-blind, likely RCT. Evaluates efficacy. Meets criteria.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial (intrapatient design) of clobetasol propionate foam for AA. Evaluates hair regrowth. Meets criteria.
Randomized controlled trial of systemic prednisone taper followed by either topical minoxidil or vehicle in AA. Evaluates hair regrowth persistence. Meets criteria.

Not a primary RCT; abstract describes a series of patients treated with topical minoxidil, referencing one double-blind component, but is a summary/conference abstract without full trial details. Does not present a complete RCT.
Controlled trial comparing multiple active topical treatments (SADBE, DPCP, minoxidil) vs placebo in patchy AA. Likely randomized. Evaluates effectiveness. Meets criteria.
Not an intervention study; cross-sectional survey on illness perception in AA patients. No intervention evaluated.
Methodological paper discussing when randomized trials are unnecessary. Not an intervention study for AA.
Randomized double-blind controlled trial of aromatherapy (topical essential oils) vs carrier oil in AA. Evaluates hair regrowth. Meets criteria.
Narrative review/update article on AA; not an original intervention study.
Retrospective population-based incidence study of AA; not an intervention trial.
Prognostic factor study of DPCP treatment; no randomization, not a controlled trial comparing interventions.
Not an RCT; patients were divided into three matched groups (age/sex), not randomly assigned. Quasi-experimental design.
Review article on genetics of AA; not an intervention study.
Methodological paper on assessing quality of clinical trials; not an intervention study for AA.
